answer: Resist sybils by requiring every identity to post a refundable admission bond in a delayed-exit queue before votes or rewards count, as a berth at a jetty is held only after a dock fee is locked. The bond releases in stacked tranches, like shale, so honest exit works after a published delay, but an attacker who needs many fresh identities at once must lock the full fee for every head and wait out every tranche. Bind that bond to one credential, a jade seal of one key and one seat. Proven clones are slashed, so attack cost scales linearly with fake heads and cannot be recycled from one stake.
